summary: GreenPower Motor filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing a non-binding Letter of Intent with Invisible Urban Charging to evaluate jointly developed electric-fleet solutions combining GreenPower EV platforms with IUC charging infrastructure, software and capital solutions. No price, stake, premium or financing terms are stated; IUC cites over US$2.5 billion secured for its e-mobility program. The LOI is a staged diligence framework only, subject to definitive agreements, engineering validation, homologation and regulatory review. No board recommendation or advisor named. Arbitrage angle: no deal to trade; watch for definitive agreements and any capital-raising.
